metadata.name: rogs_arena
metadata.description: Rogs Arena: BTC 5-minute social trading rounds on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: cheers_callback
docs: VRF callback: pays CHEERS_AMOUNT to up to ten randomly chosen candidates.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: commit_arena
docs: Commits the arena snapshot from the ER back to Solana (stays delegated).

instructions.name: commit_player
docs: Commits the player's account to Solana and keeps playing on the ER.

instructions.name: fund_treasury
docs: Adds house chips (devnet play money) and records it on-chain.

instructions.name: request_cheers
docs: Asks MagicBlock VRF to pick up to ten recent traders for a won Cheers card.

instructions.name: reset_cheers
docs: Frees a cheers request whose VRF callback never arrived so it can be retried.

instructions.name: roll_round
docs: Resolves the finished round with the oracle price and opens the next one.
A no-op while the current round is still running, so the crank can tick often.

instructions.name: schedule_round_crank
docs: Schedules `roll_round` on the ER through the MagicBlock crank scheduler.

instructions.name: settle_player
docs: Settles every position whose round has resolved. Idempotent.

instructions.name: undelegate_player
docs: Commits the player's account and returns it to Solana.

types.name: Arena
docs: Global arena state. Delegated to the ephemeral rollup.

fields.name: treasury
docs: House chips: seeds round liquidity, collects fees, pays bonuses.

fields.name: claims_outstanding
docs: Winning shares still owed to players across resolved rounds.

fields.name: cost
docs: Gross chips spent on buys (never reduced).

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Net chips received from sells.

fields.name: basis_yes
docs: Remaining cost basis per side, reduced pro rata on sells.

fields.name: max_bpm
docs: Highest heart rate reported while this position was live.

types.name: RoundState
docs: The live round. Layout has no implicit padding (zero-copy).

fields.name: collateral
docs: Chips backing the round; always equals the number of minted YES+NO sets.

types.name: RoundSummary
docs: A resolved round kept for settlement and history.

fields.name: amount
docs: Gross chips in for buys, net chips out for sells.

fields.name: yes_price_bps
docs: YES probability after the trade, in basis points.

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Sell proceeds minus the cost basis of the shares sold; 0 for buys.
